summary: the time autocorrelation of a quantity sampled at a fixed interval, averaged over the time origins of each series and over independent series

inputs.name: series
inputs.meaning: one or more lists of values of one quantity, each sampled at the same interval from an equilibrium run; independent runs, or independent and alike components (xy, xz, yz of a stress)

inputs.name: interval
inputs.meaning: the time between two consecutive values, in the unit of time of the run

inputs.name: max_lag
inputs.meaning: the largest lag, in samples, for which the correlation is computed; every series must be longer than it

outputs.name: correlation
outputs.meaning: pairs [lag time, C], lag time = lag x interval, C the mean over the series of the mean over time origins of a(t0) a(t0 + lag), in the square of the unit of the values

outputs.name: pairs_at_max_lag
outputs.meaning: the number of time origins the largest lag had in the shortest series

outputs.name: why
outputs.meaning: why nothing was computed; absent when computed

validity: a stationary series sampled at equal intervals; no mean is subtracted, so a quantity whose mean is not zero gives the correlation of its full value, not of its fluctuation; the statistical error grows with the lag and this skill does not estimate it (the source's equations (7) and (8) do)

source.citation: Kim, Han, Kim, Li, Karniadakis and Lee (2018), Nature of intrinsic uncertainties in equilibrium molecular dynamics estimation of shear viscosity for simple and complex fluids, arXiv:1807.08063v1 (read 2026-11-21, https://arxiv.org/pdf/1807.08063v1; mat-20261121-kim-2018-green-kubo-uncertainty)
source.locus: equation (3): the autocorrelation C(t) = <a(0) a(t)> is estimated as the ensemble average over N independent sample trajectories of the time average over origins t' of a(t') a(t' + t); section III: the shear stress was sampled at a fixed interval and the SACF computed by a standard time-averaging procedure

note: Written for meta_agent/tasks/034, where a HOOMD-blue agent reads the relaxation of an Oldroyd-B fluid of Hookean dumbbells from the xy stress of an equilibrium Brownian-dynamics run. The discrete time average divides by the number of origins a lag has (n - lag), the time average of equation (3) over the origins the series holds. No value of the source stands behind the worked cases: each is worked by hand in its worked field, on two unrelated kinds of system. v2 (tasks/034, failure bd-2): a value that is not a finite number is refused with a why, where v1 carried it into its output; seen when HOOMD-blue's pressure tensor, read on steps it had not computed, came back as not-a-number and v1 of exponential_decay_fit said fitted.
